decisions.name: Decide_Parent_Is_GC
decisions.label: Decide Parent Is GC
decisions.description: Two gates in one decision. (1) GDD.ParentRecordId is polymorphic (Campaign / GiftCommitment / Opportunity) — only route to the GC recalc when the parent is a GC (key prefix 6gc). (2) Skip when the running user holds the FQS_Bypass_Automation custom permission so data-migration bulk deletes stay lightweight; run scripts/apex/fqs-recalc-gc-fulfillmenttype.apex afterwards to reconcile. BeforeDelete precludes a filterFormula gate (see [[flow-recordbeforedelete-filterformula-silent-skip]]), so both checks live here.

Flow.description:
Fundraising Quick Start: on delete of a GiftDefaultDesignation whose parent is a GiftCommitment, triggers FQS_Recalculate_GC_FulfillmentType against the parent GC so removing the last restricted designation flips FulfillmentType back to Unconditional.
Deliberately uses BeforeDelete + no filterFormula on the trigger — per the flow-recordbeforedelete-filterformula-silent-skip precedent (non-trivial start filters on managed-object delete flows silently prevent firing). Parent-type gating happens inside the flow via a Decision element on the ParentRecordId key prefix.
Timing: BeforeDelete fires while the row is still visible to queries. Passes excludeGDDId = $Record.Id so the recalc subflow's GDD query filters it out — deleting the last restricted GDD correctly flips FulfillmentType to Unconditional at the same commit.
